name: qlrisk_xva
title: XVA and CVA capital
description: Valuation adjustments and CVA capital. measure cva (unilateral or bilateral, analytic or Monte Carlo, optional wrong-way), dva, fva, kva, mva run qlrisk's calculators on an exposure profile; 'total' runs any of them together (inputs: {cva: {...}, dva: {...}, ..., colva: number}) and sums them; 'sa_cva' is the MAR50 standardised CVA capital from an expected-exposure profile and the counterparty's credit curve, with optional hedge trades; 'ba_cva' is the basic approach (reduced, or full with hedges). Units: probabilities, LGDs, recoveries, rates, haircuts and volatilities in percent (pd_pct 2 = 2%), spreads in basis points (credit_spread_bp 120 = 1.2%), maturities and horizons in years, margin periods in business days; amounts in the trade currency. Fields: cva: ee_profile*, time_grid* (years), credit_spread_bp* (bp), recovery_pct (%, default 40), spread_term_structure_bp (bp), discount_rates_pct (%), risk_free_rate_pct (%, default 5), own_credit_spread_bp (bp), own_recovery_pct (%, default 40), notional (default 1.0). dva: exposure_profile, time_grid (years), own_pd_curve_pct (%), own_lgd_pct (%, default 60), discount_curve_pct (%). fva: exposure_profile, time_grid (years), funding_spread_bp (bp, default 100), discount_curve_pct (%), counterparty_survival_curve_pct (%). kva: ead_profile, time_grid (years), counterparty_pd_pct (%, default 1), counterparty_lgd_pct (%, default 45), cost_of_capital_pct (%, default 10), discount_curve_pct (%), capital_floor_pct (%, default 0.03). mva: initial_margin_profile, time_grid (years), funding_spread_bp (bp, default 100), discount_curve_pct (%). Config: cva: method (analytical|monte_carlo|sa_cva), bilateral, wrong_way_risk, wwr_correlation. Inputs: measure, inputs, counterparty, time_grid, expected_exposure, recovery_pct; the rest (config, market_data, reporting_currency, counterparty_buckets, hedges, m_cva, reference_buckets, counterparties, index_hedges) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"measure": "cva", "inputs": {"ee_profile": [400000, 600000, 700000, 650000, 500000], "time_grid": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], "credit_spread_bp": 100, "recovery_pct": 40}} gives CVA: 19,637.64 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
